name: 13_polymorphic_ast_eval_500k
description: Polymorphic AST evaluator. Tree of mixed node kinds (Add/Sub/Mul/Mod/Min/Max/IfPos/Const/Var) built deterministically from an LCG; each kind is a distinct type implementing Eval(env). 33 walks per outer call drives ~500k virtual-method dispatches per inner timing window. Stresses interface / virtual method dispatch.
